Parser package: ParseLine classifies git push stderr into progress/refUpdate/remoteMessage/error/upToDate/noise with \r splitting
Theme package: loads colors/icons JSON, resolves branch/remote colors via bin-zsh, converts ANSI indices to lipgloss colors
TUI package: bubbletea Model rendering progress bar with phase name, percentage, and themed color via bubbles/progress ViewAs

Wired main.go: arg parsing with branch/remote resolution, subprocess spawning with --progress, stderr streaming via custom \r/\n scanner, TUI message routing (done/error/upToDate), context-based Ctrl+C cleanup, errors to stderr
Manual smoke test: build verified, all 51 tests green, TTY required for visual verification by user
Styled summary line: NewWithSummary config, RefUpdateMsg/RemoteMessageMsg types, lipgloss-colored branch/remote names, ref range or up-to-date, remote messages after summary
Ctrl+O raw output toggle: RawLineMsg type, rawLines buffer, showRaw toggle in Update, separator+lines in View, RawPanel() accessor for post-exit printing
